scope: Verified slide-to-live-layer following with pinned forecast dates and legends, plus native SDK Basemap Gallery in the evidence pane.

automated.deploymentChecks: Syntax, geometry/watchpoint/camera/reservoir contracts, HLS integrity, page links and public config passed.
automated.newCases: Exact PDF hash/verification; threshold and absolute UTC-period matching after source cycle rollover; no substitution for missing periods; explicitly related rainfall/WSSI overlap; actual controller cancellation and unmapped-page clearing; periodic re-resolution and cycle change between resolution and display; workspace basemap memory.

browser.slideFollowing: Slide 6 selects quarter-inch period 2; Next page selects half-inch period 3 for slide 7's later dates; slide 8 clears the old forecast and legend. Rapid previous-page navigation returns to slide 6 without late source replacement.
browser.manualMode: Turning Auto-sync off retains an independent live map across page changes; turning it back on for unmapped slide 8 clears the forecast and explains the missing mapping.
browser.phone390x844: Map, preview, navigation, forecast dates and complete percentage legend remain visible after advancing slides. Date/legend header stays above the scrolling original preview. Responsive override reset after test.
browser.basemapGallery: Native component shows Dark Gray, Light Gray, Imagery Hybrid. Verified actual selection changes, independent Roads/Weather restoration, phone-to-desktop reparenting, and gallery rebinding after 2D/3D transition.
browser.symbology: Source hazard renderers and probability palette retained. County labels/outlines adapt to chosen dark/light basemap. No new hazard thresholds or dispatch logic.
browser.accounts: Anonymous public-data workflow tested. No new private-account or permission acceptance claims.

reviewedAssociations.provenance: Original partner slide previews visually reviewed; exact UTC periods encoded in site/lib/briefing-follow-model.js. Other pages and PDF revisions remain unmapped.
reviewedAssociations.limitations: WPC single rainfall amounts do not reproduce Hanford ranges. WSSI overall periods may differ. Exact-period ERO/probability products are withheld when unavailable. Latest cycle and publisher colors may differ from archived slides. No source identity is inferred from page numbers alone.
